summary: To migrate a role: rename it with underscores instead of hyphens, copy it into <collection>/roles/, copy its plugins into the collection's plugins/ directory, and update playbooks to the fully qualified name. The scaffold's default run role stays; roles with module_utils imports may need code changes.
questions: How do I move an existing role into a collection?
Where do role plugins go when migrating to a collection?
What is the run role in a scaffolded collection?
Why does my Galaxy role break after moving it into a collection?

answer_card.title: Migrate a standalone role into a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Rename the role directory so it has no hyphens (use `_`), e.g. `acl_config`.
2. Copy it into `<collection>/roles/`, e.g. `myapp_network/roles/acl_config`.
3. Copy the role's plugins into the collection's `plugins/` directory.
4. Call the role by its fully qualified name in playbooks, e.g. `company_namespace.myapp_network.acl_config`.

Roles whose plugins import from `module_utils/` may need their imports changed.
